Grilled chicken Alfredo pasta is a delicious and popular dish that combines tender grilled chicken with creamy Alfredo sauce and pasta.  Ingredients: . 3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts marinated with 👇🏻 . 1 tbsp smoked paprika  . 1/2 tbsp black pepper  . 1/2 tbsp salt  . 1/2 garlic powder  . 1/2 tbsp dried parsley  . A pinch of rosemary  Penne pasta (boiled)  Alfredo sauce : . 4 tbsp butter  . 1/4 cup all purpose flour  . 8 oz milk  . 1/2 cup heavy cream  . 3 tbsp cream cheese  . 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese  . 1/3 parmesan cheese . 1 tbsp red chili flakes  . Salt and pepper to taste  . 1 tbsp dried parsley  . 1 tbsp oregano  .Grill the chicken for about 6-8 minutes per side or until cooked through.  Remove from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes. Then, slice the chicken into thin strips. . In a large skillet, heat the butter over medium heat.  . Add all purpose flour, make it smooth make sure the heat is low. Add milk keep stirring add cream cheese. Add heavy cream. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth and creamy. . Add all the seasonings. . Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss it in the Alfredo sauce until well coated. .Add mozzarella cheese and grated Parmesan  . Place the sliced grilled chicken on top of the pasta. . Garnish with  parsley. Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. hot honey garlic chicken tenders 🔥🍯✨ - crispy, golden brown tenders coated in a garlicky sweet and spicy sauce is pure perfection with each bite!  what you’ll need:  Chicken Tenders  Dry Mixture  • 1 1/2 cups flour  • 1/4 cup corn starch  • 1 tsp baking powder • 1 tsp salt  • 1/2 smoked paprika  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder • 1/2 tsp onion powder  • 1/2 tsp black pepper  Wet Mixture  • 1 1/2 pound chicken tenders  • 1 cup buttermilk • 2 tbsp hot sauce  • 1/2 tsp salt  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  • 1/4 tsp black pepper  • 1/4 tsp garlic powder  • 1/4 tsp onion powder  • 2-3 cups neutral oil, for frying  Hot Honey Garlic Sauce  • 1/2 cup hot sauce • 1/2 cup honey  • 2 tbsp butter  • 4 garlic cloves, minced  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  • 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper  here’s how to make it:  Chicken Tenders - In a bowl, mix together the tenders and all of the wet mixture ingredients (except for the oil). Cover and marinade for 1-4 hours or overnight in the fridge. In a separate bowl, whisk together all of the dry mixture ingredients. Mix in 2-3 tbsp of the wet mixture to form a crumbly texture. Individually, coat each tender in the dry mixture. Transfer to a wire rack to rest for 10-12 min. Heat oil in a frying pan to 350F. In batches, fry the tenders, 3-4 min per side or until golden brown. Transfer to paper towel lined baking sheet. Hot Honey Garlic Sauce - in a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add and sauté the garlic until fragrant, 1-2 min. Pour in the hot sauce, honey and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a low boil. Cook sauce for 4-5 min while stirring to thicken up slightly. Remove from heat. Set aside. Assembly - place fried tenders in a large bowl. Pour sauce over tenders and mix to coat. Serve coated tenders with sauce of choice and enjoy!!  #hothoney #chickentenders #FoodTok #garlic #Recipes

sugar cookie cinnamon rolls 🎄✨   recipe: tangzhong: ¼ cup milk (60g) 1 tbsp all-purpose flour (8g) whisk together in a small pan over medium-low heat until it thickens into a paste. let cool slightly before adding to the dough. cinnamon roll dough: ¾ cup warm milk (180ml) ¼ cup melted butter (57g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 1 tsp almond extract  1 tsp cake batter extract  tangzhong 3 cups bread flour (360g), plus up to ½ cup (60g) as needed 2 tbsp milk powder (15g) ¾ tsp salt (4g) mix the warm milk, sugar, and yeast together and let sit for about 5 minutes until foamy. add the melted butter, egg, egg yolk, and tangzhong. mix until combined. add the milk powder and salt, then gradually add the flour. start with 3 cups and add more as needed until you have a soft, smooth dough. i ended up using about 3½ cups total. if kneading by hand, try not to add too much extra flour. lightly oil your hands and work surface if needed. place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled, being careful not to overproof. sugar cookie filling: ½ cup salted butter, softened (113g) ¾ cup granulated sugar (150g) 1 egg  1 tsp vanilla extract ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150g) 1 tsp cinnamon  ¼ tsp salt cream together the softened butter and sugar until fluffy. mix in the egg, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. gradually add the flour and and salt until a soft cookie dough forms. assembling the rolls: once the cinnamon roll dough has doubled in size, roll it out into a rectangle, keeping it about ¾ inch thick. spread the sugar cookie dough evenly over the surface. sprinkle Christmas nonpareils over the sugar cookie layer. cut the dough into approximately 12 strips, then roll each strip individually. arrange the rolls in a lined baking dish. cover and let rise again for about 25–35 minutes, until slightly puffier. don’t let them overproof. before baking: heavy cream, for brushing lightly brush the tops of the rolls with heavy cream before baking. bake at 350°F for about 25–30 minutes, or until cooked through. baking time may vary depending on your oven. if This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Bala baiana! These are Brazilian coconut bob bons! My friend @KITCHENTOOL thanks for the recipe! I searched so many recipes and his is the easiest to follow in my opinion! Check his page out! Ingredients: 1 tbsp salted butter 1 can (14oz)sweetened condensed milk  2/3 cup sweetened coconut flakes  Sugar coating: 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tbsp vinegar  How to: In a sauce pan add butter and turn it on medium heat until melted. Next add in sweetened condensed milk and coconut flakes. Stir on medium heat for 5-7 minutes until the mixture is thickened and can pull away from the pan. Add it into a separate bowl and place in the refrigerator until cooled.  Once cooled, take a tbsp of the mixture and roll it between greased hands to form a ball and place it onto a parchment lined pan until all of the mixture is formed into bite sized balls. Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Next insert a toothpick into each ball and dip it into the amber sugar and place back onto a parchment lined pan.  Let cool and serve! #dessert #coconut #balabaiana #easyrecipe #recipeshare

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Arayes 🥙 This is one of the best Mediterranean meals you can easily make at home in about 30 minutes. Crispy pita stuffed with seasoned beef, cooked until golden, and finished with a creamy garlic sauce. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more weeknight staples. Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, grated onion, garlic, jalapeño, tomato paste, parsley, cilantro, olive oil, ice water, and spices until fully combined and slightly sticky. 3. Cut the pitas in half and gently open each pocket (heat the pitas in the microwave for a few seconds first to make them easier to open). Spread a thin layer of the meat mixture inside each pita, then brush the outside generously with olive oil. 4. Heat a pan over medium heat. Cook the arayes meat side down first for 1–2 minutes until charred, then flip and cook each pita side until golden and crispy. 5. Finish in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the meat reaches 155°F internally. 6. While the arayes cook, mix together all sauce ingredients until smooth. 7. Brush the hot arayes with olive oil mixed with minced garlic and parsley, then serve with the dipping sauce. #easydinners #arayes #pita

🧑🏽‍🍳 livthepositivefooodie🧑🏽‍🍳  My oven baked chicken recipe with some red pesto thrown into the mix! Served with rice this time instead of spaghetti BUT this would be unreaaaaaaal with some pasta 😮‍💨 My fave thing about this recipe is it’s literally a case of throwing it ALL into an oven dish and letting it cook! That’s it!! Plus the Parmesan sprinkled on top makes it go really crispy and it’s beaut 🥵 Ingredients to serve two: 2 large chicken breasts 2 handful cherry tomatoes 60g reduced fat soft cheese / single cream 2tbsp red pesto 10g Parmesan 200mls chicken stock cube 1tsp paprika, mixed Italian herbs, garlic, salt and pepper To serve: basmati rice and broccoli Method: Preheat your oven to 200, then add your chicken to an oven dish with some oil followed by the cherry tomatoes. Season your chicken with the paprika, mixed Italian herbs, salt and pepper. In a jug, make up the chicken stock and then add in the soft cheese (or cream) and stir until the cheese dissolves. Pour this into the oven dish. Add the pesto in, putting some on the chicken itself and some into the sauce and giving it a stir. Pop this into the oven for 25-30 mins. Make sure tour chicken breast is cooked through and piping hot before serving. Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars 🎄✨ (recipe makes an 8x8 pan)  Ingredients: ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter, room temp 2 oz (56g) cream cheese, room temp 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar  1 egg, room temp 1½ tsp vanilla  ¼ tsp almond extract 1⅔ cups (210g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in)  ½ tsp baking powder ½ tsp salt Frosting: 4 tbsp (57g) unsalted butter, room temp 1⅓ (160g) cups powdered sugar  1-2 tbsp milk or heavy cream (adjust for desired consistency)  ½ tsp vanilla Pinch of salt + christmas sprinkles for topping! Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease/line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper.  Beat butter, cream cheese, and sugar together until combined. Then, add the egg, vanilla, and almond extract and mix until fully combined.  In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt, then gently fold into the wet ingredients until just combined.  Spread evenly into the prepared pan, smoothing out the top.  Bake for 20-25 minutes, until the edges are set or a toothpick inserted comes out clean/mostly clean.  Let it cool completely.  For the frosting, beat the butter until creamy, then mix in the powdered sugar, milk, vanilla, and salt until smooth/spreadable.  Spread over the completely cooled bars and decorate with christmas sprinkles. Enjoy! ✨ #bakingrecipe #sugarcookies #christmascookies #christmasbaking #christmasrecipe

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

videos.caption: 30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

videos.caption: This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! All the credit goes to @Allyssainthekitchen for this AMAZING recipe! 🫶🏼 #ChickenThighRecipe #SundayDinner #EasyDinnerIdeas #ViralRecipes #FamilyDinner

Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Garlic Parmesean Wraps✨🧄🌯 #homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #dinnerideas #homecooking Recipe:  For the Chicken • 3 chicken breasts, butterflied • Olive oil • Paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, thyme, cayenne, red pepper flakes, ginger garlic paste  Fries: • 2 large russet potatoes, cut into fries • Avocado oil, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt & pepper Garlic Parmesan Sauce: • 2 tbsp butter • ½ diced onion • 4 minced garlic cloves • 1 cup heavy cream • Garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne & fresh parsley • ½–1 cup Parmesan cheese Wraps: • Large tortillas • Parmesan & optional mozzarella Instructions: 1. Season chicken with olive oil and all seasonings. Sear in avocado or olive oil until golden and cooked to 165°F. Set aside. 2. Soak fries in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain, dry, season, and bake at 425°F for about 40 minutes, flipping halfway. 3. In the same pan, melt butter. Sauté onion, then garlic for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, seasonings, and parsley. Stir in Parmesan and simmer on low until thick. 4. Add sauce, fries, chicken, and cheese to a tortilla. Fold tightly and toast in an oiled pan until golden on both sides. 5. Serve with extra garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping and a side kale salad. 🤍

Sticky Chicken & Rice!✨🍚#homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #budgetrecipes #DinnerIdeas  Recipe:  Chicken: * 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cubed * 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder & salt * ½ tsp each black pepper & paprika * 2 tbsp olive oil * ⅓ cup cornstarch * Olive oil for cooking Sticky Sauce: * ½ cup soy sauce * ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce * 1 tbsp ketchup * 1 tsp ginger paste * ½ tbsp minced garlic * 1½ tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp butter For serving: White rice, green onions & sesame seeds Instructions 1. Season chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika and olive oil. Toss with cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients except the butter until smooth. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 4. Reduce heat and melt butter in the same skillet, scraping up the browned bits. 5. Pour in the sauce and stir until thickened. Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

High Protein Cheesy & Creamy Garlic Chicken Quesadillas🍗🧀🧄 68g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 Don’t forget to check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes just like this👨🏻‍🍳 (Macros: Per Quesadilla - 10 Total) 468 Calories 23gC | 15gF | 68gP Ingredients:  1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tbsp All Purpose Seasoning 1 Tsp Olive Oil 100ml Chicken Broth 8 Diced Garlic Cloves 350ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder (Vegeta) & 1 Tsp Oregano 100g Light Cream Cheese 40g Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese Chopped Spinach 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Large Tortillas) 50g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (per quesadilla - Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with all purpose seasoning (or your choice of seasonings) add a drizzle of olive oil & mix well. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side with a lid on top or until fully cooked through. Once cooked set aside. 3. Deglaze the pan with chicken broth then add diced garlic, let it cook & add fat free evaporated milk along with smoked paprika, chicken stock powder, oregano, light cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese & stir well until smooth & creamy.  4. Add chopped spinach to the sauce & let it simmer on low heat, while simmering shred the chicken apart using 2 forks then place the shredded chicken back into the pan. 5. Mix the creamy garlic sauce & chicken well to combine. 6. Place down a warm tortilla, add light cheddar cheese to one half of the tortilla along with a portion of the filling, another layer of cheddar & fold the tortilla over.  7. Toast the quesadilla on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas & enjoy! #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Follow for more #mealprep #roasted #chicken #parmesan #healthyrecipes

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Recipies below ⬇️ Bread Recipe: •4 cups bread flour (500g) •1½ cups + 1 tbsp warm water (375g) •2¼ tsp instant yeast (7g) @fleischmannsyeast  •1¾ tsp salt (10g) •2 tsp honey (10g) Mix water, honey, yeast, flour, and salt until just combined and sticky. Cover and rise 1½–2 hrs, doing 3–4 folds every 30 min. Divide into 3, shape, and proof 30–45 min. Score and bake at 475°F with steam for 10 min. Reduce to 450°F and bake 12–18 min until deeply golden. Cool 30 min before slicing. Chicken Au Poivre: •8 chicken thighs (bone-in + skin on)  seasonings: chicken soup blend, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper. •3 tbsp unsalted butter  •1 shallot  •3 garlic cloves  •1/4 cup light brandy  •1 cup chicken stock  •2 cups heavy whipping cream  •2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper  •1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary  •1 tbsp dijon mustard  •1 tbsp worcestershire sauce  •salt to taste  Sear chicken skin side down first for 25 minutes on low heat until golden, then flip and allow to cook another 10 minutes. Set chicken aside, add in butter, shallots and cook down for 1-2 minutes. Then add in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. You may need a few extra minutes in the oven! #easyrecipes #quickrecipe #cinnamonrolls #floridablogger #tastewithnicki

Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. CREAMY GARLIC PASTA & STEAK RECIPE🍝🥩 Creamy, garlicky, packed with flavor, and ready in about 20 minutes. This rich tomato cream sauce paired with juicy steak is one of those meals that feels fancy but couldn’t be easier to throw together. Save this one for your next pasta night! ❤️🍝🥩 Creamy Garlic Pasta & Steak Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients 16 oz rigatoni 1 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 1 cup diced onion 4–5 garlic cloves, minced 4 tbsp tomato paste 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp red pepper flakes Salt & pepper, to taste 2 cups heavy cream 1 cup reserved pasta water (plus more if needed) ½ cup grated Parmesan 2 strip steaks or ribeye Instructions 1. Cook the rigatoni according to the package directions, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining. 2. While the pasta cooks, season the steak with your favorite steak seasoning and let it sit at room temperature for 20–30 minutes. 3. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet. Add the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add the tomato paste, paprika, Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring often, until the tomato paste darkens slightly. 5. Pour in the heavy cream and whisk until smooth. Stir in the reserved pasta water and let the sauce simmer for 7–8 minutes. 6. Mix in the Parmesan until melted, then toss in the cooked rigatoni. Add a splash of extra pasta water if you’d like a thinner sauce. 7. Sear the steak in a very hot skillet for about 3–4 minutes per side (depending on thickness and desired doneness) until a golden crust forms. Let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 8. Top the creamy pasta with sliced steak and enjoy! #easyrecipe #quickmeal #mealprep #tastewithnicki #floridablogger

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Creamy lemon chicken makes a quick easy and delicious dinner perfect for those busy nights. 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp pepper  1/4 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour  1/2 cup shredded Parm 4 cloves crushed garlic 2 tbs freshly squeezed lemon juice  1 tbs lemon zest 1 tbs olive oil 4 tbs butter 1 cup heavy whipping cream  1 cup water For the sauce: I/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp salt Season chicken breast with seasoning on both sides then brown in a pan over high heat in olive oil. Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add butter and one melted, add garlic. Sauté for a minute and then add in flour and sauté an additional minute. Add in water, lemon juice, and heavy cream. Once the sauce comes together, add in lemon zest, Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper. Stir until the cheese is fully melted then add the chicken back to the pan. Cover with the lid and simmer for five minutes. Spoon the sauce over the chicken.
